title: Scalar Arithmetic on NumPy Arrays
description: Demonstrates how adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing by a single scalar broadcasts across every element.
code:
import numpy as np

numbers = np.array([10, 20, 30])

print("Original:", numbers)
print("Add 5:", numbers + 5)
print("Subtract 5:", numbers - 5)
print("Multiply 2:", numbers * 2)
print("Divide 2:", numbers / 2)
explanation: Every element receives the scalar operation independently. True division (/) automatically casts integer elements to floating-point numbers.

title: Array-to-Array Element-Wise Arithmetic
description: Perform element-by-element product and subtraction across matching-shape arrays to model store revenue.
code:
import numpy as np

prices = np.array([100, 200, 50])
quantities = np.array([2, 3, 4])

# Element-wise multiplication: prices * quantities
total_sales = prices * quantities
print("Total Sales:", total_sales)

# 10% discount
discount = total_sales * 0.10
print("Discount:", discount)

# Array - Array subtraction
final_amount = total_sales - discount
print("Final Amount:", final_amount)
explanation: Corresponding items at index 0, 1, and 2 are multiplied and subtracted position-by-position without writing a single for-loop.

title: Multi-Step Formula: Celsius to Fahrenheit
description: Vectorized unit conversion applying standard algebra F = (C * 9 / 5) + 32 across an array of temperatures.
code:
import numpy as np

celsius = np.array([0, 10, 20, 30])

# Vectorized conversion formula
fahrenheit = (celsius * 9 / 5) + 32

print("Celsius:", celsius)
print("Fahrenheit:", fahrenheit)
explanation: NumPy evaluates mathematical expressions with standard operator precedence across every value in the array in C-speed vector operations.

title: Targeted Updates with Slicing & Arithmetic
description: Combine row and column indexing with arithmetic to apply bonuses to specific sections of a gradebook.
code:
import numpy as np

marks = np.array([
    [70, 80, 90],
    [60, 75, 85]
])

# Add 5 bonus marks only to the first student (row 0)
marks[0] = marks[0] + 5
print("After Row 0 +5:\n", marks)

# Add 10 bonus marks only to Science (column 2)
marks[:, 2] = marks[:, 2] + 10
print("\nAfter Science (Col 2) +10:\n", marks)
explanation: Indexing and slicing isolate specific array slices so mathematical operations can be applied selectively without affecting other students or subjects.
